messages.subject: item fit error
parts:
Hi Phil,

Hope all is well. I'm not sure if this error is a bug or if I'm doing something wrong, but when I try to run the S-X2 item fit stat on a random subsample of my data, it is throwing the following error: "Error in -pick : invalid argument to unary operator". 

   mbi2.items.disc.on.genfact.1500 <- sample_n(mbi2.items.disc.on.genfact, 1500) #takes random sample of 1500 cases from dataframe
    irt12.1500 <- mirt(mbi2.items.disc.on.genfact.1500, irt12.model, itemtype = "graded", SE = TRUE, SE.type = "Oakes")
   irt12.itemfit.1500 <- itemfit(irt12.1500, fit_stats = 'S_X2', na.rm = TRUE) #error thrown after running this line of code

Thank you!
Keri

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: item fit error
parts: So this dataset crashed because there is a column of ID variables included in the model, which should be excluded since it causes a tale of counts with exactly one observation per cell. There's also no missing data, so this runs fine.

pain.df500 <- dplyr::sample_n(pain.df2, 500) #take random sample of 500 cases from full promis pain dataset
pain.irt.500 <- mirt(pain.df500[,-1], pain.model, itemtype = "graded", SE = TRUE, SE.type = "Oakes")
itemfit(pain.irt.500, fit_stats = 'S_X2') #error thrown here

Does your dataset have similar problems? Also, I've added a stop() message when na.rm is used when there is no missing data. 

Phil
